get.description: Read a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include in the response. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to retrieve associated object IDs and archived records.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties of the specified objects, resulting in a single object with merged data. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify related data under a single object.

primaryObjectId.description: The ID of the object that will remain after the merge.

schema.description: Input data for merging two records.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: An integer representing the ID of the user who last updated the value.

value.description: The value associated with the timestamp. It is a string representing the data captured at a specific point in time.

items.description: Property model that includes timestamp.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of historical values, each containing a value and a timestamp.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL of this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each containing a category, message, and context.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with string properties.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object, identified by its type and ID, and target object type. The maximum number of associations that can be retrieved per call is 500.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the target object for which associations are being retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to fetch the next page of results.

link.description: A URL string that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object includes details about the associated object and its labels.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each including a label and type information. This defines the types of associations between the objects.

category.description: The category of the association, which can be HUBSPOT_DEFINED, USER_DEFINED, or INTEGRATOR_DEFINED.

fromObjectTypeId.description: The object type ID of the source object in the association.

label.description: A human-readable name for the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: The object type ID of the target object in the association.

typeId.description: The unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The ID of the object to which the associations are made.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
